about: A self-hosted web page for managing Traefik, a program that routes web traffic to services.

prs.title: Deleting a route keeps services other config files still use
prs.broken: With several config files, deleting or disabling a route removed its service even when a route in another file still used it, so that other route stopped working.
prs.changed: The app now checks every config file before removing a service.
prs.matters: Changing one route no longer quietly takes down another site.
